The '''Hidden Republic lab''' was a research facility operated by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Galactic Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR:BaBB" />
